metadata.description: This endpoint allows you to record the percentage of media that has been played.
metadata.learn_more: This endpoint allows you to record the percentage of media that has been played. It is useful for tracking user engagement with media content, such as videos or audio files, by capturing the extent to which the media has been consumed. This data can be used for analytics and improving content delivery strategies.

_hsenc.label: Hsenc
_hsenc.description: HubSpot encoding parameter for tracking purposes.

contactId.label: Contact Id
contactId.description: The unique identifier for the contact associated with the media play event.

contactUtk.label: Contact Utk
contactUtk.description: The user token key associated with the contact.

externalId.label: External Id
externalId.description: An external identifier for the media, provided by the user.

externalPlayContext.label: External Play Context
externalPlayContext.description: Additional context provided externally about the media play event.

mediaBridgeId.label: Media Bridge Id
mediaBridgeId.description: The unique identifier for the media bridge instance.

mediaName.label: Media Name
mediaName.description: The name of the media that was played.

mediaType.label: Media Type
mediaType.description: The type of media that was played. Valid values include 'VIDEO', 'AUDIO', 'DOCUMENT', 'OTHER', and 'IMAGE'.

mediaUrl.label: Media Url
mediaUrl.description: The URL where the media is hosted.

occurredTimestamp.label: Occurred Timestamp
occurredTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the media play event occurred.

pageId.label: Page Id
pageId.description: The unique identifier for the page where the media was played.

pageName.label: Page Name
pageName.description: The name of the page where the media was played.

pageUrl.label: Page Url
pageUrl.description: The URL of the page where the media was played.

playedPercent.label: Played Percent
playedPercent.description: The percentage of the media that has been played.

sessionId.label: Session Id
sessionId.description: The unique identifier for the session in which the media was played.
